label: TP
reason: The user-provided header name (param) is directly used in constructing the file path via 'bar' from a HashMap key, which then becomes part of the filename in 'org.owasp.esapi.ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML(fileName)'. Since the input comes from an untrusted HTTP header and flows into a file system operation through path concatenation, this constitutes a path traversal vulnerability where arbitrary paths can be constructed.

evidence.note: User-provided header name is extracted and stored in param, then passed to doSomething() and used as a HashMap key, ultimately forming the filename via bar.
